richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to oil starvation caused by incorrect tolerances third gear may seize on the gear box main shaft. Should this occur the possibility exists that the rear wheel could lock whilst the machine was being ridden.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will have 3rd and 4th gears replaced additionally the gearbox main shaft.
